evidence.estrutura: Huerta built grassroots organizations and unions while lobbying state and federal institutions. This supports bottom-up community organization combined with willingness to use higher-level government for labor protections.
evidence.representacao: Voter registration, candidate forums and Latina political participation have been central to her work, strongly supporting inclusive democratic representation.
evidence.poder: Her organizing confronted abusive labor conditions and she was repeatedly arrested during nonviolent activism. This supports civil-liberty protections and skepticism toward coercive suppression, alongside acceptance of labor regulation.
evidence.imigracao: Her movement defended migrant farmworkers from Mexico, the Philippines and other communities and emphasized equal treatment regardless of background. This supports an inclusive immigration and multicultural orientation.
evidence.diplomacia: Her activism is domestic and movement-based rather than foreign-policy centered. Nonviolent coalition-building supports a cooperative orientation but not an extreme diplomacy score.
evidence.intervencao: Her organizing explicitly embraced nonviolent action and social movements rather than military coercion, supporting a strongly restrained position.
evidence.economia: Union organizing for wages, contracts and worker protections strongly supports labor power, redistribution toward workers and constraints on employer dominance within a mixed economy.
evidence.controle: She supports collective bargaining, labor standards and public protections, indicating significant regulation without comprehensive state planning.
evidence.comercio: Her boycotts were labor-organizing tools rather than a general tariff doctrine. Use moderate-to-managed openness rather than a strong trade extreme.
evidence.religiao: Her movement included faith and community networks but her public program is civil-rights based rather than religiously governed. Use a secular-pluralist state position.
evidence.moral: Her work for workers, women, Latinos and underrepresented groups strongly supports progressive equality and inclusion.
evidence.tecnologia: No distinctive technology ideology is central to her record. Use a moderate pragmatic position.
